english.note: Use 一份 for a distinct portion or an allocated share, especially when each person receives one.

exampleSentences.english: Everyone gets a proportion of the bonus.
exampleSentences.jyutping: mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 jat1 fan6 zoeng2 gam1

english.note: Use 一份 for a defined portion or serving of something.

exampleSentences.english: I’d like a bit of cake.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 fan6 daan6 gou1

english.note: Use this when the portion is separately allocated, served, presented, or treated as one share.

exampleSentences.english: The company says everyone will get a parcel of the bonus.
exampleSentences.traditional: 公司話每人都有一份花紅。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gung1 si1 waa6 mui5 jan4 dou1 jau5 jat1 fan6 faa1 hung4
